Hide a single photo from Photos or keep a single file in Private, uploads that carry on with the iPhone locked, and a Mac that pastes from Finder and selects as Finder does.

More about it, and step-by-step install guides, at https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/

## Which file to download

- **Mac:** `telegrive-1.2.0-macos.dmg`, for Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 12 or newer. See [Opening it on a Mac](#opening-it-on-a-mac) below.
- **Android, most phones:** `telegrive-1.2.0-arm64-v8a.apk`
- **Android, older phones:** `telegrive-1.2.0-armeabi-v7a.apk`
- **Chromebooks and emulators:** `telegrive-1.2.0-x86_64.apk`
- **iPhone:** `telegrive-1.2.0.ipa`, installed with Sideloadly, SideStore or AltStore and your own Apple Account. Follow the [iPhone guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/iphone.html); it shows every step.

Each installs over 1.1.0, and keeps your drive and settings. `telegrive-1.2.0.aab` is the same Android app as a bundle for app stores; you don't need it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.

## Opening it on a Mac

Open the disk image and drag Telegrive onto Applications. Apple hasn't checked the app, so your Mac won't open it straight away the first time. The quickest way through is to paste this into Terminal and press Return:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Telegrive.app
```

Then open Telegrive from Applications. Without Terminal, open it once, click Done, and click Open Anyway in System Settings › Privacy & Security; the [Mac guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/mac.html) shows each step.

## New

- **Hide one photo from Photos.** A photo's or video's menu, or several selected in Photos or Files, keeps them out of the timeline, Favorites and Videos; they stay in Files, Search and albums. The line above the grid counts them, and Show brings them back.
- **Keep one file in Private.** Any file's menu, or several selected, moves them to Private, behind your fingerprint, face or Touch ID, where they're listed below your private folders. They leave Files, Photos, Search and Home on every device signed in.
- **Uploads carry on with the iPhone locked.** On iOS 26 or later, an upload or download you start keeps going with the screen locked or another app open, and its progress shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, where you can stop it.
- **Pause an upload while it's being prepared**, as a long video from the photo library is copied in. It pauses once the file is ready, before anything is sent.

## On a Mac

- **Paste files from Finder.** Copy files or folders in Finder, then press Cmd-V in Telegrive to upload them to the folder that's open, just as dropping them does.
- **A click highlights, as in Finder.** One click highlights a file without turning the page into a selection, a double-click opens it, and selecting several starts with Cmd-click, Shift-click or a month in Photos. While selecting, a click adds a file or takes it out.
- **Home is just Home.** Transfers and Settings are in the sidebar, so Home's top no longer repeats them.

## Fixes

- Show in folder now finds the file in a big folder shown as a grid, keeps it tinted long enough to spot, and on a Mac leaves it highlighted.
- On a phone, a long menu no longer rises under the status bar where it couldn't be pulled down.

## Support

Telegrive is free, with no ads. If it's useful to you, you can [send a tip on Jami](https://jami.bio/daveragoose). If something doesn't work, [report a problem](https://github.com/daveragos/telegrive/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
